one_liner_zh: Nike EPS 0.35 美元大超預期24%，但營收持平年增0.1%，轉型成效初現、成長動能仍待回穩。
one_liner_en: Nike beat EPS at $0.35 by 24% but revenue was flat at 0.1%, with turnaround signs emerging amid still-soft growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 24.31%（獲利優於估計），惟營收年增僅 0.09% 近乎持平。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：EPS 大超預期顯示成本與庫存管理見效，但營收近乎零成長凸顯需求復甦仍緩，轉型尚在早期。短期獲利驚喜或提振股價，但市場將檢視營收是否觸底回升。中期追蹤毛利率回升、新品週期、北美與中國市場銷售動能，以及批發/直營再平衡成效。30倍本益比要求轉型加速兌現。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly positive: the large EPS beat shows cost and inventory management working, but near-flat revenue underscores a slow demand recovery with the turnaround still early. Near term the surprise may lift the stock, though the market will watch whether revenue troughs and re-accelerates. Mid term, track gross margin recovery, the product cycle, North America and China momentum, and channel rebalancing. A ~30x P/E demands faster execution.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.35 美元，超預期 24.31%，成本與庫存管理改善
毛利率受清庫存與直營調整影響趨穩
品牌轉型與創新產品線重整推進中
直營（DTC）與批發通路再平衡
highlights_en: EPS of $0.35 beat by 24.31% on improved cost and inventory management
Gross margin stabilizing after destocking and DTC adjustments
Brand turnaround and product innovation pipeline progressing
Rebalancing between DTC and wholesale channels
risks_zh: 營收近乎零成長，需求復甦力道有限
中國市場與運動鞋競爭（On、Hoka）加劇
本益比約30倍，估值已部分反映轉型樂觀預期
risks_en: Near-flat revenue signals limited demand recovery
China market softness and competition from On, Hoka
P/E of ~30x prices in some turnaround optimism
